thread:
sara: Quick question — legal needs a 30-day snapshot of "who did what" audit logs for a compliance request. Prefer CSV with columns (time, actor, action, resource, details). Who's the right approver and what's the simplest redaction we can run?

maria: Who's asking from legal? are they going to need unhashed ids or is hashed/opaque ok? Also need to know if free-text details should be redacted.

sara: Request came from oliver@legal (Oliver). They said they only need to map events to internal user IDs, not emails. Free-text may contain PII — they'd prefer redacted/free-text removed if possible.

ajay: We have an export pipeline. For redacted exports we usually use the audit.sanitized_events view (removes emails, hashes user ids with per-org salt). Output options: CSV, TSV, parquet. CSV size might be big for 30d but fine for a snapshot.

ajay: Quick perms note: export requires security+legal approval, and we run the job under role audit-exports-role that writes to s3://redwood-audit-exports/temp/<job-id>. Temp exports auto-ttl after 7 days unless otherwise requested.

maria: @oliver can you confirm hashed IDs + removal of free-text is acceptable for your request? Also confirm who from legal will pick up the mapping if needed.

oliver: Confirmed — hashed IDs are fine, we don't need raw emails. If legal needs mapping later we will request it and justify it in a separate approver flow. Please remove free-text fields or strip PII.

dmitri: I can run the export once @maria signs off. SQL I typically use for a sample:

```sql
SELECT event_time, actor_id_hashed AS actor, action, resource_id, redacted_details AS details
FROM audit.sanitized_events
WHERE event_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 100000;
```

Command to push to S3 (example):

```bash
psql -h audit-db -U readonly -c "\copy (\<above query\>) TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER" | aws s3 cp - s3://redwood-audit-exports/temp/1799998888-audit-snapshot.csv --profile audit-exports
```

devops-bot: Export job A-1234 created by dmitri, role=audit-exports-role. ETA ~7 minutes. Object: s3://redwood-audit-exports/temp/1799998888-audit-snapshot.csv (ttl 7d).

ajay: One more note — retention policy: raw event stream retained 12 months in parquet, then archived. Exports are ephemeral; if legal wants longer retention for this snapshot we'll need a ticket and approval to extend TTL.

sara: Perfect — @maria do you approve? If yes I'll cc oliver and close the loop.

maria: Approved. run it and set ACL so only audit-exports-role + oliver@legal can access. :lock:

sara: Thanks all — I'll let legal know and mark this as completed once file is uploaded. :thumbsup:
